title: Add collection assignment to NFT upload form and reduce Mint button size

requirements.summary: Add collection selector to NFT upload form for assigning NFTs to existing collections at creation time
acceptanceCriteria: A collection dropdown/selector is visible in the NFT upload form
The dropdown is populated with collections fetched from the backend
The selected collection is passed along when creating/minting the NFT
If no collection is selected, the field is either optional or shows a clear placeholder

file_operations.description: Add a collection selector dropdown to the NFT upload form that fetches available collections using the useGetAllCollections hook. The selector should allow users to pick a collection before submitting. Pass the selected collectionId to the backend when creating the NFT via useCreateNFT. Ensure the field shows a clear placeholder if no collection is selected and handle the case where collections are still loading.

Add a collection selector dropdown to the MintNFTModal component that fetches available collections using the useGetAllCollections hook. The selector should allow users to assign the NFT to a collection before minting. Update the mint flow to pass the selected collectionId. Ensure the field shows a clear placeholder if no collection is selected and handle loading states appropriately.

requirements.summary: Reduce the visual size of the Mint button to be proportionate with other form controls
acceptanceCriteria: The Mint button is no longer visually dominant compared to other form elements
The button size is consistent with the general button style used elsewhere in the app

file_operations.description: Reduce the size of the Mint/Upload button by removing excessive padding, decreasing font size, or adjusting width to make it proportionate with other form controls (input fields, dropdowns). Ensure it matches the button styling used elsewhere in the application for consistency.

Reduce the size of the Mint button in the modal by adjusting its padding, font size, or width to be proportionate with other form elements. Ensure the button styling is consistent with the general button style used throughout the app.
